column3: requireReauth re-proves the caller and is not invalidated by a concurrent writer. The state the activation depends on (which TOTP secret the code was validated against) is re-asserted by a conditional write: since #2655 ActivateMFASecret is UPDATE ... WHERE user_id = ? AND secret_enc = <validated ciphertext>, returning matched=false when a concurrent BeginMFAEnrollment swapped the secret, and ActivateMFA then fails closed (ErrMFAEnrollmentChanged) and rolls back the whole activation. Guard: TestCTAReview_ActivateMFA_vs_BeginMFAEnrollment_CrossReplicaPostgres, TestActivateMFA_SecretSwappedAfterValidation_FailsClosed.
